arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْمَقْطُوعِ الْوَتينِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alal maqţūil watīn,
english_text: Peace be upon the one whose aorta was severed.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْمُحامي بِلا مُعين،
transliteration: assalāmu alal muħāmī bilā muīn,
english_text: Peace be upon the defender who had no helper.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الشَّيْبِ الْخَضيبِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alash-shaybil khađhīb,
english_text: Peace be upon the gray hair that was dyed (with blood).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْخَدِّ التَّريبِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alal khaddit-tarīb,
english_text: Peace be upon the cheek that struck the dust.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْبَدَنِ السَّليبِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alal badanis-salīb,
english_text: Peace be upon the butchered body.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الثَّغْرِ الْمَقْرُوعِ بِالْقَضيبِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alath-thaghril maqrūi bil qađhīb,
english_text: Peace be upon the front teeth that were beaten with a rod.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ الْمَرْفُوعِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alar-ra'sil marfū,
english_text: Peace be upon the head raised (upon a lance).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الأجْسامِ الْعارِيَةِ فِي الْفَلَواتِ، تَنْهَشُهَا الذِّئابُ الْعادِياتُ، وَ تَخْتَلِفُ إلَيْهَا السِّباعُ الضّارِياتُ،
transliteration: assalāmu alal 'ajsāmil āriyati fil falawāt, tanhashuhadh-dhi'ābul ādiyāt, wa takhtalifu 'ilayhas-sibāuđh-đhāriyāt,
english_text: Peace be upon the unclothed corpses in the desert, bitten by wild wolves[1] and around whom the beasts of prey prowled.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا مَوْلايَ وَ عَلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ الْمُرَفْرَفينَ حَوْلَ قُبَّتِكَ،
transliteration: assalāmu alayka yā mawlāy wa alal malā'ikatil murafrafīna ħawla qubbatik,
english_text: Peace be upon you, O my master, and the Angels who flutter around your dome,

arabic_text: الْحافّينَ بِتُرْبَتِكَ، الطّائِفينَ بِعَرْصَتِكَ، الْوارِدينَ لِزِيارَتِكَ،
transliteration: al-ħāffīna biturrbatik, aţ-ţā'ifīna biaršatik, al-wāridīna liziyāratik,
english_text: surround your grave, circumambulate your courtyard, and come for your visitation.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ فَإنّي قَصَدْتُ إلَيْكَ، وَ رَجَوْتُ الْفَوْزَ لَدَيْكَ،
transliteration: assalāmu alayka fa'innī qašadtu 'ilayk, wa rajawtul fawza ladayk,
english_text: Peace be upon you! Indeed, I intended your visitation, and I am hopeful of achieving the prosperity that is with you.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ
transliteration: assalāmu alayka,
english_text: Salutations to you,

arabic_text: سَلامَ الْعارِفِ بِحُرْمَتِكَ، الْمُخْلِصِ في وِلايَتِكَ، الْمُتَقَرِّبِ إلَى اللهِ بِمَحَبَّتِكَ، الْبَريءِ مِنْ أعْدائِكَ،
transliteration: salāmal ārifi biħurmatik, al-mukhliši fī wilāyatik, al-mutaqqarribi 'ilal-lāhi bimaħabbatik, al-barī'i min 'adā'ik,
english_text: Salutations from he who recognizes your sanctity, is a sincere (believer) in your guardianship, seeks nearness to Allah through your love, and is aloof from your enemies,

arabic_text: سَلامَ مَنْ قَلْبُهُ بِمُصابِكَ مَقْرُوحٌ، وَ دَمْعُهُ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِكَ مَسْفُوحٌ،
transliteration: salāma man qalbuhu bimušābika maqrūħ, wa damuhu inda dhikrika masfūħ,
english_text: Salutations from the one whose heart is wounded due to the tribulations you have suffered, and whose tears flow in your remembrance,

arabic_text: سَلامَ الْمَفْجُوعِ الْحَزينِ، الْوالِهِ الْمُسْتَكينِ،
transliteration: salāmal mafjūil ħazīn, al-wālihil-mustakīn,
english_text: Salutations from the one who is distressed, grief-stricken, distracted, and yielding,

arabic_text: سَلامَ مَنْ لَوْ كانَ مَعَكَ بِالطُّفُوفِ، لَوَقاكَ بِنَفْسِهِ حَدَّ السُّيُوفِ، وَ بَذَلَ حُشاشَتَهُ دُونَكَ لِلْحُتُوفِ،
transliteration: salāma man law kāna maaka biţ-ţufūf, lawaqāka binafsihi ħaddas-suyūf, wa badhala ħushāshatahu dūnaka lil ħutūf,
english_text: Salutations from the one, who, had he been present with you in that plain, would have shielded you from the sharpness of the swords with his body and sacrificed his last breath for you,

arabic_text: وَ جاهَدَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَ نَصَرَكَ عَلى مَنْ بَغى عَلَيْكَ، وَ فَداكَ بِرُوحِهِ وَ جَسَدِهِ وَ مالِهِ وَ وَلَدِهِ،
transliteration: wa jāhada bayna yadayk, wa našaraka alā man baghā alayk, wa fadāka birūħihi wa jasadihi wa mālihi wa waladih,
english_text: would have struggled beside you, helped you against the aggressors, and redeemed you with his soul, body, wealth, and children,

arabic_text: وَ رُوحُهُ لِرُوحِكَ فِداءٌ،
transliteration: wa rūħuhu li rūħika fidā',
english_text: (Salutations from the one) whose soul is a sacrifice for yours,

arabic_text: وَ أهْلُهُ لِأهْلِكَ وِقاءٌ،
transliteration: wa 'ahluhu li 'ahlika wiqā',
english_text: and whose family is a shield for yours.

arabic_text: فَلَئِنْ أخَّرَتْنِي الدُّهُورُ، وَ عاقَني عَنْ نَصْرِكَ الْمَقْدُورُ،
transliteration: fala'in 'akh-kharatnid-duhūr, wa āqanī an našrikal maqdūr
english_text: But as I have been hindered by the course of time and as (Allah’s) decree has prevented me from helping you,

arabic_text: وَ لَمْ أكُنْ لِمَنْ حارَبَكَ مُحارِباً، وَ لِمَنْ نَصَبَ لَكَ الْعَداوَةَ مُناصِباً،
transliteration: wa lam 'akun liman ħārabaka muħāribā, wa liman našaba lakal adāwata munāšibā,
english_text: and as I could not fight those who fought you, and was not able to show hostility to those who showed hostility to you,

arabic_text: فَلَأَنْدُبَنَّكَ صَباحاً وَ مَساءً وَ لَأَبْكِيَنَّ لَكَ بَدَلَ الدُّمُوعِ دَماً، حَسْرَةً عَلَيْكَ وَ تَأسُّفاً عَلى ما دَهاكَ وَ تَلَهُّفاً،
transliteration: Fala'andubannaka šabāħan wa masā'ā, wa la'abkiyanna laka badalad-dumūi damā, ħasratan alayka wa ta'assufan alā mā dahāka wa talahhufā,
english_text: I will, therefore, lament you morning and evening, and will weep blood in place of tears, out of my anguish for you and my sorrow for all that befell you,

arabic_text: حَتّى أمُوتَ بِلَوْعَةِ الْمُصابِ، وَ غُصَّةِ الإكْتِيابِ،
transliteration: ħattā 'amūta bilawatil mušāb wa ghuššatil 'ikti'yāb,
english_text: until I meet death from the pain of the catastrophe and the choking grief.

arabic_text: أشْهَدُ أ نَّكَ قَدْ أقَمْتَ الصَّلوةَ، وَ آتَيْتَ الزَّكوةَ،
transliteration: 'ash-hadu 'annaka qad 'aqamtaš-šalāt, wa ātaytaz-zakāt,
english_text: I bear witness that you certainly established prayer, gave alms,

arabic_text: وَ أمَرْتَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ، وَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَ الْعُدْوانِ،
transliteration: wa 'amarta bil marūf, wa nahayta anil munkari wal udwān,
english_text: enjoined good, forbade evil and transgression,

arabic_text: وَ أطَعْتَ اللهَ وَ ما عَصَيْتَهُ، وَ تَمَسَّكْتَ بِهِ وَ بِحَبْلِهِ
transliteration: wa 'aţatal-lāha wa mā ašaytah, wa tamassakta bihi wa bi ħablih,
english_text: obeyed Allah, never disobeyed Him, and held fast to Him and to His rope.

arabic_text: فَأرْضَيْتَهُ وَ خَشيتَهُ وَ راقَبْتَهُ وَ اسْتَجَبْتَهُ،
transliteration: fa 'arđhaytahu wa khashaytahu wa rāqabtahu wastajabtah,
english_text: Then, you pleased Him, held Him in awe, were attentive towards Him, and were responsive to Him,

arabic_text: وَ سَنَنْتَ السُّنَنَ، وَ أطْفَأْتَ الْفِتَنَ،
transliteration: wa sanantas-sunan, wa 'aţfa'tal fitan,
english_text: established the customs (of the Prophet (PBUH&HF)), extinguished turmoil (in religion),

arabic_text: وَ دَعَوْتَ إلَى الرَّشادِ، وَ أوْضَحْتَ سُبُلَ السَّدادِ، وَ جاهَدْتَ فِي اللهِ حَقَّ الْجِهادِ،
transliteration: wa daawta 'ilar-rashād, wa 'awđhaħta subulas-sadād, wa jāhadta fil-lāhi ħaqqal jihād,
english_text: invited people to rectitude, clarified the ways of righteousness, and truly strove in the way of Allah.

arabic_text: وَ كُنْتَ للهِِ طائِعاً،
transliteration: wa kunta lil-lāhi ţā'iā,
english_text: You were an obedient one to Allah,
